purpose.title: Purpose of data processing
purpose.text: ExamCraft AI processes personal data solely to provide the AI-assisted exam assistant: user accounts, document processing, question generation, grading suggestions and communication. Processing is based on the GDPR or the revised Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (nDSG).

hosting.title: Hosting and data location
hosting.text: The platform is operated in the Fly.io region Frankfurt (Germany). Databases, vector DB and message queue run in the same region. Error tracking is handled via Sentry with DE ingest and masked data.

subprocessors.title: Processors and subprocessors
subprocessors.intro: We use carefully selected processors to provide our services. A complete list with hosting locations and third-country transfer mechanisms can be found in our DPA annex.
subprocessors.note: Note: The subprocessor list is updated continuously. We inform responsible parties in good time of material changes.

ai.title: Transmission of content to AI models
ai.humanInTheLoop: ExamCraft AI follows a human-in-the-loop approach: the AI generates suggestions for exam questions and grading, which must be reviewed and approved by a teacher before leaving the system. Personal data of students is minimized before AI processing wherever possible.
ai.intro: ExamCraft uses AI models through a central LLM gateway for functions including the following:

functions.label: Question generation
functions.description: Topic, difficulty level, question types, language, and the content of selected documents (for document-based generation).

functions.label: Help chat
functions.description: Your question, matching documentation excerpts, the chat history so far, and your role, subscription tier, and current page.

functions.label: Automatic grading
functions.description: Question text, model answer, grading criteria, and the answer text entered by the student.

functions.label: Document indexing
functions.description: When a document is uploaded, its content is split into text chunks and sent to an embedding model for full-text search (RAG) — independent of whether a question is later generated from it.

ai.premiumNote: Institutions with Premium features also use the document-based chat assistant and the prompt wizard, which transmit content to the LLM gateway following the same principle.
ai.notTransmittedText: Names, email addresses, student IDs, grades, or other structured personal data of students or teachers. If a student's own free-text answer contains personal information, that content is not filtered out.
ai.gatewayNote: Whether the data leaves the EU depends on the configuration of the LLM gateway. Please contact your institution for details on the specific configuration.

rights.access: Right of access to processed data (Art. 15 GDPR)
rights.restriction: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)

use.title: Permitted use
use.text: ExamCraft AI may only be used for creating and correcting exam questions in a school or university context. Any misuse is prohibited.

ai.title: AI-generated content
ai.text: The AI provides suggestions. The responsible teacher retains the pedagogical final decision and final grading. ExamCraft AI does not guarantee the factual correctness of individual suggestions.
